children: American Atomics plans a non-brokered private placement of 10M to 15M units at C$0.07 each, for gross proceeds of up to C$1.05M. It may also settle up to C$200K of debt through units on the same terms.
Offering targets up to C$1.05M gross
Provides potential funding, but the release does not state that subscriptions are secured or the offering has closed.
The share issuance would dilute existing holders; each unit also includes half a warrant.
May settle up to C$200K of debt in units
Could reduce cash debt obligations, while adding further equity dilution; settlement is not confirmed.
Warrants exercisable at C$0.10 for 24 months
Potential future share issuance depends on warrant exercise; the exercise price is above the unit price.
Proceeds intended for working capital and G&A
The stated use is general operating needs, not a specified project investment.

This is a financing announcement for an exploration and development company, rather than a report of operating or project results. Completion of the placement, regulatory approvals, and any debt settlement would determine the realized funding and dilution.
